purpose: Canonicalize duplicate identity IDs discovered by the repository primary-name uniqueness guard without rewriting historical curation manifests.

supersessions.reason: Both IDs denoted the same Lesotho Correctional Service; retain the descriptive canonical ID and preserve LCS as its alias.
Both IDs denoted Manila Police District; retain the descriptive canonical ID and preserve MPD as its alias.
Both IDs denoted Philippine National Police; retain the descriptive canonical ID and preserve PNP as its alias.

nonInference: ID supersession is identity normalization only.
Supersession does not create equivalence between distinct real-world actors.
Canonicalization does not create attribution, participation, control or governance semantics.
